title: Restaurant reservations
bodyMd: A restaurant began requesting a refundable deposit for large-party reservations. No-shows fell, but fewer large parties booked. The manager described the policy as successful because empty reserved tables were now rare. The chef asked whether the restaurant earned more after refunds, payment-processing fees, and the lost bookings were considered. The available report measured attendance and booking counts, not net earnings.
